# Version 4.155.0 (Unreleased)
> **Linux font discovery restored**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.155.0 restores system-font discovery for Linux applications using the NoDependencies package.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Linux NoDependencies system fonts restored** — Applications using the Linux NoDependencies package can again discover and use fonts installed on the system. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5086))
